item.title: Pulldown Device
item.description: The pulldown device (PDD) is a claw-like device that pulls on the knitted fabric to provide takedown force.

item.title: Front Body Back Body
item.description: If you want more freedom to specify different knit structures on the front face and back face of the fabric, you can create 3 compressed patterns.

item.title: X-Bed
item.description: “X-bed” refers to a four needle bed flat knitting machine configuration. ”V-bed” refers to a two needle bed configuration.

item.title: About
item.description: PZ: These are notes based on personal experience with a Shima Seiki MACH2XS153-15L and MACH2X M173X15L, and passing experience with shaping machines (SVR123SP, SES122S, SCG122SN), a Mini machine (SWG091N2), and a Kniterate.

item.title: Automatic Software
item.description: If I remember correctly, Shima Seiki calls it automatic software. The SUTD researchers call this New File Format.
